premises.text: Local news sharing and reporting is currently inadequate
premises.evidence_span: there's a problem out there. And the problem is that sharing and getting news right now kind of sucks.

premises.text: MePorter allows users to report and update local news in real time
premises.evidence_span: MePorter is your local mobile news desk, allowing you to report, update, and read local news as it happens on your mobile phone.

premises.text: The app provides a location-based check-in service for eyewitness reporting
premises.evidence_span: we allow anybody to post news, and it gets pinpointed to a map.

premises.text: A rewards program incentivizes users to post news
premises.evidence_span: we have a rewards program that we've built out in the app as well to reward people for posting the news.

premises.text: Users can access news stories through a map interface or a list view
premises.evidence_span: you can read them off the map, or if you want to, you can click the newswire and actually get a list view of everything that you've seen.

premises.text: The app allows users to categorize and post news stories live
premises.evidence_span: if you have a newsworthy item, we make it very easy for you to post it live.

premises.text: The platform integrates with a website for broader access to local news
premises.evidence_span: if you visit Meeporter.com, all you have to do is search for local news in your area.

premises.text: The app allows users to accumulate badges for rewards
premises.evidence_span: we give away badges or what we call press passes.

premises.text: MePorter plans to monetize through promoted stories and advertising
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow people to actually promote their news stories at the top of the search results.

premises.text: Corporate sponsors are involved in the platform to incentivize user engagement
premises.evidence_span: Forbes is a current sponsor of ours, and they're giving away a free six-month subscription to Forbes magazine for anybody that posts 10 stories in the business section.

value.text: Local news becomes more accessible and engaging through user-generated content
value.evidence_span: we want to incentivize people for posting news in their local areas.
